_meta.title: Olive Pizza — Website Routes & Page Guide
_meta.description: Complete map of all website routes, their purpose, and what features each page contains.

routes.name: Home
routes.description: Main homepage with featured products, daily deals, hero banner, quick category pills, and top recommended pizzas carousel.
features: Quick category access (Pizzas, Garlic Breads, Drinks, Combos)
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Take me home' or 'Go to homepage'.

routes.name: Menu
routes.description: Full live menu with all pizzas, sides, beverages, and combos fetched from Firestore. Filter by category, search by name, toggle veg filter.
features: Product cards with Add to Cart
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Show me the menu', 'Open menu', or 'Find me a spicy pizza'.

routes.name: Cart
routes.description: Review all selected items, update quantities, remove items, apply coupon codes, see price breakdown (subtotal, delivery charge, GST, total).
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Open cart', 'Show my cart', or 'What's in my cart?'.

routes.name: Checkout
routes.description: 3-step checkout: (1) Select or enter delivery address, (2) Choose payment method (UPI, Card, COD, Net Banking), (3) Review and place order.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Go to checkout', 'Proceed to payment', or 'Place my order'.

routes.name: Order Tracking
routes.description: Real-time live order tracking with status updates (Placed → Preparing → Out for Delivery → Delivered), delivery partner info, and ETA.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Track my order', 'Where is my order?', or 'What is my delivery status?'.

routes.name: Customer Dashboard
routes.description: Customer account dashboard with order history, saved addresses, profile settings, loyalty points, and 1-click repeat order.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Go to my dashboard', 'Show my order history', or 'View my account'.

routes.name: AI Assistant
routes.description: Full-page AI Concierge chat interface. Ask anything about menu, orders, policies, or get guided through placing an order.
features: Add to Cart from AI chat
routes.aiNavigation: This is the current page. You are already on the AI Assistant.

routes.name: About Us
routes.description: Learn about Olive Pizza's story, mission, quality commitment, and team.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Tell me about Olive Pizza' or 'Open About page'.

routes.name: Contact Us
routes.description: Contact form, live phone number, email, WhatsApp link, Google Maps location, and store operating hours.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Contact support', 'How do I reach you?', or 'Open contact page'.

routes.name: FAQ
routes.description: Frequently asked questions about orders, delivery, refunds, payments, account management, and menu customization.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Show me FAQ', 'I have a question about...' — or just ask me directly!

routes.name: Privacy Policy
routes.description: How Olive Pizza collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Privacy policy' or 'How do you handle my data?'.

routes.name: Refund Policy
routes.description: Rules for refunds on incorrect, damaged, or poor-quality orders. Refund window, process, and timelines.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Refund policy', 'How do I get a refund?'.

routes.name: Terms & Conditions
routes.description: Legal terms for using the Olive Pizza website, app, and placing orders.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Terms and conditions' or 'Terms of service'.

routes.name: Cancellation Policy
routes.description: How and when you can cancel an order, and what happens if you do.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Cancellation policy' or 'How do I cancel my order?'.

routes.name: Delivery Policy
routes.description: Delivery zones, estimated times, charges, and rules for Olive Pizza deliveries.
routes.aiNavigation: Say 'Delivery policy', 'Delivery area', or 'Do you deliver to [location]?'.

routes.name: Login
routes.description: Sign in with Google, phone OTP, or email.

routes.name: Register
routes.description: Create a new Olive Pizza account.
